name: Jill
source:
Steve's ex-girlfriend. She wants to become a lawyer and strives hard for that goal. She feels that Steve needs to have some sense knocked into him, which is why she thinks Steve being sent to Fairbrook is a good idea.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Flower_Shop]Wikipedia[/url]]
